profile.headline: Software Engineer/Developer, Contractor in Financial Management Directorate of Air Force Reserve Command at Robins Air Force Base

positions.title: Software Engineer/Developer
positions.locationName: Robins Air Force Base/Air Force Reserve Command/Financial Management Directorate
positions.description: Maintaining the Reserve Travel System (RTS) client-server software application.  Maintaining the RTS Reports web-based software application.  Maintaining applications related to RTS SSIS processes. Developing RTS related SQL scripts as needed to support data requests.  Worked on a project to try to convert the RTS client-server software application into a web-based software application.  Supported the development of SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) software applications.  Using/used Microsoft Visual Studio ASP/VB/C#.NET with Web & Windows Forms, Bootstrap, Infragistics, SignalR, Crystal Reports, Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio & Integration Services & Reporting Services, Red Gate SQL Compare & Data Compare, Subversion, and JIRA.

company.name: Digital Management Incorporated (DMI) & Immersion Consulting & Teksouth Corporation

positions.title: Computer Programmer
positions.description: Maintained Automobile Dealer Management Software consisting of the integration of Microsoft Visual Studio Visual Basic and C# .Net software, DevExpress UI Controls, AmyUni PDF Converter, Postgres databases, web services, and websites using Git for software configuration management and Driven for work order management.  Duties included the maintenance of user interfaces, maintenance of financial software, maintenance of prospect management software, maintenance of multi-threaded communication management software, maintenance of software to produce output (such as receipts, reports, and exports), implementation of internal and third party web service integrations, integration with credit reporting agency, and related activities.

positions.title: IT Applications Designer
positions.description: Maintained Aircraft Product Lifecycle Management Software which consisted of the integration of Microsoft Visual Studio Visual Basic .Net software, Oracle PL/SQL, SmarTeam, and CATIA.  Duties included the monitoring of processes to validate aircraft configuration data, maintenance of user interfaces, modification of reports, and management of tubing data.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Duties, Responsibilities and Skills:	Developed computer aided maintenance tools to manipulate aircraft structural and electronic data.  Performed complexity analysis of assembly language software used in aircraft for control of radar systems.  Supported software development for an expert system to maintain a logistics database and for a special operations forces reliability database.  Supported software development for a radar frequency target generator and for precision location and identification simulation modeling.  Supported software development for digital data delivery, storage, and distribution.  Developed and supported computer based training applications associated with database software applications and interactive electronic technical manuals.  Performed artificial intelligence related enhancement of a signal processing database.  Performed electronic warfare and information operations related research, analysis, software development, and simulation modeling.  Most recently supported aircraft avionics including software, hardware, system, management, and financial efforts.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Duties, Responsibilities and Skills:	Participated in the development of a method for generating synthetic imagery.  Maintained and modified hardware-in-the-loop simulation of end game automatic target recognizer which used image processing for targeting.  Maintained and modified computer simulation of battlefield in support of military contracts including developing and assisting in development of various post-processors.  Maintained and modified graphics display program associated with battlefield simulation, and developed and presented related graphics demonstrations.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description: Duties, Responsibilities and Skills:	Performed applications programming in support of radar design and analysis.  Developed and maintained various computer simulations related to military contracts.  Analyzed and reduced data gathered from radar systems and wind tunnel tests.  Performed systems programming including writing software for color graphics terminal and plotter.
